macros.name: AddToSIstyle
macros.doc: The \AddToSIstyle appends formatting commands to a locale. The starred form clears the list before appending.

macros.name: ang
macros.doc: The \ang command is supplied by the SIstyle package to typeset angles.

macros.name: num
macros.doc: The \num command simplifies the input of numbers and typeset them correctly.

macros.name: SI
macros.doc: The \SI command typeset SI numbers with units and it conforms to the rules as given in Part 2.

macros.name: SIdecimalsign
macros.doc: User command to set decimal sign.

macros.name: SIdefaultNfam
macros.doc: The default upright math font for typesetting numbers.

macros.name: SIdefaultTfam
macros.doc: The default text font for units set inside a \mbox, such as symbols from the textcomp package.

macros.name: SIstyle
macros.doc: The main command to activate a spesific style.

macros.name: SIstyleToLang
macros.doc: Links a locale to the babel language changing \extrashlangi.

macros.name: SIunitdot
macros.doc: Inside the \SI command the point, “.”, is make active and redefined to \SIunitdot.

macros.name: SIunitsep
macros.doc: User command to set unit separation width from the number.
